purpose: Full readback-only requalification of the existing immutable 152-case Windows correctness evidence with the repaired independent verifier. No candidate execution, build, timing, substitution, retry or selective case read is permitted.

corrected_predicate: An inactive selected chunk is internally consistent only when chunk quiet_ticks equals sleep_after_quiet_ticks, every block is inactive, and every inactive block quiet count is either zero (never activated) or exactly the sleep threshold.
At least one inactive selected block must be at the sleep threshold; inactive flags alone are insufficient.
The cumulative BlockSleep physics diagnostic must be nonzero, binding the witness to an actual source sleep transition.
The deliberately excluded resident chunk (3,0) must remain active with chunk quiet_ticks zero and at least one active block below the sleep threshold.
Prepared clear may not fabricate activity events between B and P.
Cumulative activity counters may not regress, and BlockWake must increase from Q to R, binding narrow-to-512 reentry to a real wake transition.
All pre-existing cell-state, conservation, scheduling, refusal, cross-arm and endpoint checks remain unchanged.

required_semantic_checks: sealed archive/inventory hashes and immutable execution identity
all revised negative controls and decoder crosscheck
complete cell decode, temperature, nonzero Empty/high-state and owner checks
Water/Sand source-sink conservation and closed-period accounting
resident sleep/exclusion, prepared-clear and reentry transition witnesses
all cross-arm common-control joins reached by the reader

archive_sufficiency.basis: The retained archive contains the complete registered process matrix, every full and metadata-only endpoint, full cells/ticks/operations/refusal records, activity metadata and cumulative physics diagnostics needed by the revised predicate. No new candidate observation is required by the repaired checks.
archive_sufficiency.limitation: Sufficiency is a protocol/source assessment, not semantic acceptance; the revised full readback has not been run.

nonmutation_guarantees: Read only the existing immutable retained archive.
Write verification output only to a new empty append-only output root.
Do not alter, replace, normalize, repair or regenerate any archive member.
Retain original reader source, original refusal and all prior failures unchanged.
Do not invoke candidate binaries, compiler, benchmark or timing paths.
failure_rules: Any missing endpoint or missing diagnostic refuses qualification; do not reconstruct it.
No retry of the revised full readback under the same authorization.
No selective case omission, replacement observation or fallback to the original weaker/stronger predicate.
Preserve complete revised reader output on success or failure.

supersedes.reason: Focused verifier-only run 39989589419 correctly exposed a non-isolated synthetic prepared-clear negative: its P corruption also caused a P-to-Q counter regression, so the fixture was rejected by the earlier monotonicity guard. No candidate/readback evidence was executed. v3 changes only that synthetic negative so it violates exactly the intended prepared-clear contract.
